•Game crashing in Co-Op - We've now been able to reproduce this on our end now, and aim to have it fixed in time for the next update.
•Textures not loading correctly (white boxes showing instead) - This is an issue we've been unable to track down thus far, but we're still looking into it, and your patience is much appreciated.

That's all for this update! Thanks for stopping by, and keep an eye out for more awesome new content coming soon :)

notes.title: The BTD 5 2.13 update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://ninjakiwifiles.com/assets/SteamNews/newslocal_21.png[/img]

At this special time of year we'd also like to take the time to thank every single one of our players for being awesome and playing our games. Happy Holidays from all at Ninja Kiwi!

[h1] [/h1]
[h1] New Content! [/h1]
Let's kick things off with what's new in this update! First up, we've got four awesome new tracks for you to conquer:
• Express Shipping (Beginner)
• Pyramids (Intermediate)
• Candy Land (Advanced)
• Tar Pits (Extreme)

The monkeys have also been spreading the festive cheer by decorating the main menu!
Next up is something a lot of you have been waiting for - [b] WINDOWED MODE! [/b] Yes, you can now play BTD 5 in windowed mode, which can be toggled by clicking the icon in the settings menu or by hitting F11 on your keyboard.
Also, for Windows users, there is now a close button in the main menu to allow you to exit the game.  

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]
• Potential fix for some users who's game's weren't saving.
• Fixed the crash that occurred when trying to enter Special Missions.
• Fixed bug that prevented the "Retry" button from working.
• Changed cursor size in a bid to increase compatibility with older      windows versions.
• Software cursor will now appear if user is in full screen and has pointer trails are enabled.
• Altered DPI settings to potentially fix render/non-starting issues

Happy holidays, folks! :)
